verdict.rationale: Reporting and analytics are a fair axis for a fraud and chargeback platform, but the evidence pack never mentions a dashboard, KPI reporting, or board-ready export. Nothing covers dispute rate, false-positive rate, approval-rate lift, or review workload. The cited material covers only order and decision APIs, chargeback event recording, webhooks, and marketing taglines about raising approval rates, none of which show reporting or export of these metrics.
